job.compensation: $101,000 to $175,000 base salary, plus annual incentive plan and benefits
job.rawJd:
About the role

The team

The Enterprise Solutions business within S&P Global Market Intelligence provides industry-leading data, software, and services that support investment management, enterprise data management, regulatory compliance, and private markets solutions. The Private Markets product team is responsible for products that support the entire investment lifecycle across Private Equity, Venture Capital, Real Estate, Infrastructure, and Private Credit markets. As part of the flagship iLEVEL product organization, you will work with a highly collaborative team of product leaders, technology professionals, and market experts focused on delivering innovative solutions for investment professionals. The team values customer-centricity, innovation, execution excellence, and continuous learning.

Responsibilities and impact

We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to drive our MCP & AI Agents Platform initiatives. This leader will own the vision, strategy, and execution for both the MCP connector ecosystem, enabling seamless integration of private markets data and content sources, and the AI Analyst capabilities being developed within our flagship iLEVEL platform.

As a Lead Product Manager, you will lead zero-to-one product efforts, building and scaling net new product offerings in a high-growth, fast-moving environment, leveraging agents, agentic workflows, and LLMs to build new products that deliver value to clients. This role will require working closely with engineering, design, product, data science, marketing, and go-to-market teams to drive new AI products to success.

This is a highly cross-functional and visible role suited for a hands-on builder who thrives at the intersection of AI, customer-centric product development, and financial technology.

Compensation and benefits

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $101,000 to $175,000. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan and additional S&P Global benefits.

Basic required qualifications

Experience in FinTech, SaaS, AI, or other technology-driven environments, with a track record of launching and scaling products.

Strategic and customer-focused thinker who can develop deep domain expertise, simplify complex problems, and translate insights into impactful product strategies.

Strong product operator skilled in agile delivery, product requirements, data-driven decision-making, KPI management, and cross-functional execution.

Exceptional communicator and collaborator who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can align Product, Engineering, Design, and Go-to-Market teams around a shared vision.

Additional preferred qualifications

Hands-on AI product builder with experience applying emerging AI technologies, including LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, and modern AI development tools.

paragraphs: I am applying for S&P Global Market Intelligence's Lead Product Manager, MCP & AI Agents Platform role because the work sits close to the problems I have been solving: finding a useful AI product inside a complex workflow, making the requirements concrete, and carrying the idea into a working product. My recent work covers AI product strategy, agent-assisted POCs, governed review workflows, API product strategy, customer research, and enterprise product delivery.

At Hedgehox, I turn recurring pharma agency problems into AI tools for claim review, brief intake, scoping, review routing, submission capture, and regulatory monitoring. I built the functional Claims Detector POC, shaped the investor demo, and secured an investor. Through One Block Away, I lead client discovery and use Claude Code and Codex to build working POCs from unclear questions. The work stays close to the full product loop: requirements, workflow logic, interface and backend behavior, demos, and client iteration.

Earlier, I led research and design for Kanvas, Kinesso's developer-first API services library, partnering with product and engineering on roadmap priorities and with C-suite stakeholders on monetization and go-to-market planning. I also led research and strategy for an enterprise intelligence suite used by more than 7,000 people across 22 brands. Interviews, prototype testing, beta groups, behavioral analytics, and adoption data shaped the roadmap, while close work with product, engineering, and design kept decisions moving into delivery.

This would be a domain move from regulated healthcare and marketing technology into financial information products, and I have not owned an MCP connector ecosystem. The relevant bridge is the work itself: learning a complex domain, translating customer and data needs into a product model, aligning technical and business teams, and testing whether the product is useful. I would welcome a conversation about how that experience could support the MCP and AI Analyst roadmap inside iLEVEL.
